A failure this file does not pin is a NEW RED and fails the gate; a pinned failure that stops reproducing is FIXED and must be re-recorded with its cause named, so a burn-down can never be banked silently; a pin whose set has left the census or is no longer probed is STALE. `detail` carries the discriminating payload — which children froze, which axis values collapsed, which channels are literal — so a pinned defect that CHANGES SHAPE fails as a new red rather than hiding inside an old pin. NOT a list of acceptable defects: it is the burn-down queue, written up in parity/receipts/v1/CANVAS-USABLE.md. The container is VERTICAL FIXED×HUG, primaryAxisAlignItems MIN. `label` (TEXT 74×20) is exactly as wide/tall as the container was and was fixed at that measured size rather than filling the axis, so the extra 40px becomes slack beside it — the part was lowered to the pixel size it happened to have when captured. Fix is the layout-family lowering rule: a part the source stretches (`width:100%`, `flex:1`, a block child) has to carry a fill/grow sizing decision.
